# Marlbridge

> Marlbridge is an online tutoring service for IGCSE, O Level, GCSE, AS & A Level and IB students, operated by Learners Academy in Lahore, Pakistan. Subject teachers teach live classes one-to-one or in small groups of up to 15, online for students anywhere and in person in Lahore; the first trial class is free. Classes are offered in 142 board, qualification and subject combinations (Cambridge, Pearson Edexcel, AQA, OxfordAQA, OCR and IB), and the site publishes 3,759 free study resources, printable syllabus checklists and exam tools. Marlbridge has no office outside Pakistan.

## Boards

- [AQA](https://marlbridge.com/boards/aqa/): 25 subject and qualification combinations across 3 qualifications.
- [Cambridge](https://marlbridge.com/boards/cambridge/): 54 subject and qualification combinations across 3 qualifications.
- [International Baccalaureate](https://marlbridge.com/boards/ib/): 21 subject and qualification combinations across 2 qualifications.
- [OCR](https://marlbridge.com/boards/ocr/): 12 subject and qualification combinations across 2 qualifications.
- [OxfordAQA](https://marlbridge.com/boards/oxfordaqa/): 30 subject and qualification combinations across 2 qualifications.
- [Pearson Edexcel](https://marlbridge.com/boards/edexcel/): 18 subject and qualification combinations across 2 qualifications.

## Qualifications

- [A Level](https://marlbridge.com/levels/a-level/): 59 subject and board combinations across 5 boards.
- [AS Level](https://marlbridge.com/levels/as-level/): 1 subject and board combinations across 1 board.
- [GCSE](https://marlbridge.com/levels/gcse/): 17 subject and board combinations across 2 boards.
- [IB Diploma Programme](https://marlbridge.com/levels/ib-dp/): 16 subject and board combinations across 1 board.
- [IB Middle Years Programme](https://marlbridge.com/levels/ib-myp/): 5 subject and board combinations across 1 board.
- [IGCSE](https://marlbridge.com/levels/igcse/): 45 subject and board combinations across 3 boards.
- [O Level](https://marlbridge.com/levels/o-level/): 17 subject and board combinations across 1 board.

## Free exam tools

- [Grade threshold explorer](https://marlbridge.com/grade-thresholds/): Cambridge grade boundaries by syllabus, with the official tables they come from.
- [Exam calendar](https://marlbridge.com/exam-calendar/): Cambridge entry deadlines, exam windows and results days for the next series, from Cambridge's own key-dates documents.
- [Command words](https://marlbridge.com/command-words/): what each exam command word (describe, explain, evaluate and others) asks the student to do.
- [Syllabus updates](https://marlbridge.com/syllabus-updates/): changes to syllabuses and specifications between exam years.

## Group class fees

Monthly group fees per subject by region, last confirmed 2026-08-20. One-to-one and IB fees are per class; the [pricing page](https://marlbridge.com/pricing/) has them and marks any figure that is a currency conversion rather than a set price. The first trial class is free.

- Pakistan: Rs 19,000 (GCSE, IGCSE, O Level) and Rs 24,000 (AS and A Level) per subject per month, group classes.
- Saudi Arabia: SAR 270 (GCSE, IGCSE, O Level) and SAR 330 (AS and A Level) per subject per month, group classes.
- United Arab Emirates: AED 270 (GCSE, IGCSE, O Level) and AED 330 (AS and A Level) per subject per month, group classes.
- Qatar: QAR 270 (GCSE, IGCSE, O Level) and QAR 330 (AS and A Level) per subject per month, group classes.
- Kuwait: KWD 22.5 (GCSE, IGCSE, O Level) and KWD 27.5 (AS and A Level) per subject per month, group classes.
- Bahrain: BHD 27.5 (GCSE, IGCSE, O Level) and BHD 33.5 (AS and A Level) per subject per month, group classes.
- Oman: OMR 28 (GCSE, IGCSE, O Level) and OMR 34 (AS and A Level) per subject per month, group classes.
- United Kingdom: £60 (GCSE, IGCSE, O Level) and £75 (AS and A Level) per subject per month, group classes.
- Europe: €70 (GCSE, IGCSE, O Level) and €90 (AS and A Level) per subject per month, group classes.
- Malaysia: RM 279 (GCSE, IGCSE, O Level) and RM 353 (AS and A Level) per subject per month, group classes. Indicative: a currency conversion of the Pakistan fee, confirmed in writing before any payment.
- Singapore: S$88 (GCSE, IGCSE, O Level) and S$111 (AS and A Level) per subject per month, group classes. Indicative: a currency conversion of the Pakistan fee, confirmed in writing before any payment.
- Other countries: US$69 (GCSE, IGCSE, O Level) and US$87 (AS and A Level) per subject per month, group classes. Indicative: a currency conversion of the Pakistan fee, confirmed in writing before any payment.

- [Boards directory](https://marlbridge.com/boards/): every examination board Marlbridge publishes material for.

- [Revision planner](https://marlbridge.com/revision-planner/): free weekly revision plan from a student's subjects, exam dates, free time and topic confidence; runs in the browser, no account.
- [Practice and 10-minute diagnostics](https://marlbridge.com/practice/): self-marked study checks and self-check questions with worked answers; 31 diagnostic sets across 19 syllabus codes (listed under "Diagnostics" below).
- [Printable syllabus checklists](https://marlbridge.com/checklists/)
- [Free trial class](https://marlbridge.com/trial/): request a free trial class with a subject teacher (we match a specialist teacher and confirm a time).
- [Programs](https://marlbridge.com/programs/): Marlbridge's programs by qualification; each program page says whether it is taught now.
- [Tutoring](https://marlbridge.com/tutoring/): the teachers and how classes work; each teacher's profile is listed under "Teachers" below.
- [Pricing](https://marlbridge.com/pricing/): group fees per subject per month by region, one-to-one and IB fees per class, discounts and the free trial class.
- [International online tutoring](https://marlbridge.com/international-tutoring/): all classes are taught live online from Lahore, Pakistan (in person in Lahore too); class times by time zone and fees by country. Marlbridge has no office outside Pakistan.
